features.title: The gates view
features.detail: A card per loop with its gates ticked off, and a band count of every gate in the session. Gates come from `GATES.md` files written by your own skill or script, not from the model. The rest of the mod works without them.

features.title: GATES.md format
features.detail: The ledger is `GATES.md` plus every `gates/<name>.md` in `~/.claude/gates/<repo>/<session id>/` (or under `GATES_HOME`). A gate is a line `- [ ] G1: what must hold`, with an indented `EVIDENCE:` line under it. It counts as met only when its box is `[x]` and its evidence is not `pending`. A line starting `ABANDON: G1 reason` gives that gate up. A `gates/<name>.md` file also belongs to the agent of that name.
